data.description: Kilometre or kilometer; equal to one thousand meters.
Mile; generally assumed to be statute mile, 5,280 feet or about 1609 meters.
Centimetre or centimeter, one hundredth of a metre.
Meter or metre; base unit of length in the International System of Units (SI).
Millimetre or millimeter; one thousandth of a meter.
A fathom is generally understood to be six feet, but other values have been used in various contexts.
